$schema: n/a -- internal Didact data, not a published schema
note: Core non-negotiable minimum contract: full WCAG 2.2 AA, treating 2.3.3 (AAA) as mandatory too. Each criterion maps to a specific functional requirement (RF) or component, not documented as generic 'accessible'.

criteria.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.requirement: No feedback animation may flash more than 3 times per second.

criteria.title: Animation from Interactions
criteria.levelNote: AAA level but treated as a mandatory core baseline, not optional.
criteria.requirement: Every micro-animation (Flashcard flip, transition, confetti) respects prefers-reduced-motion and offers an explicit toggle.

criteria.title: Timing Adjustable
criteria.requirement: Every exercise timer must be disableable or extendable by the user.

criteria.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.requirement: Any content moving for more than 5 seconds needs a pause control.

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.requirement: :focus-visible with sufficient contrast on every interactive control; never outline:none without a visible substitute.

criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.requirement: Glossary/Term popovers cannot cover the element that has focus.

criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.requirement: The neutral default theme fixes color tokens with a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

criteria.title: Non-text Contrast
criteria.requirement: Borders, status icons, and progress bars maintain a minimum 3:1 contrast ratio.

criteria.title: Dragging Movements
criteria.requirement: Every drag function (matching/sort/categorize) must have a single-pointer, no-dragging alternative (the 'select source, select target' pattern), in addition to keyboard support. Keyboard and single-pointer-without-dragging are NOT the same thing: dnd-kit gives keyboard support but does not by itself guarantee the two-click pattern that 2.5.7 strictly requires.
criteria.legalNote: See packages/validators/a11y/README.md for the EN 301 549 / European Accessibility Act angle.
